timeline.tl_dev_confirmed.title: Rockstar confirms the next GTA is in development
timeline.tl_dev_confirmed.body: A short Newswire post says active development of the next Grand Theft Auto is well underway.
timeline.tl_trailer_1.title: Trailer 1: back to Vice City
timeline.tl_trailer_1.body: The reveal trailer introduces the state of Leonida and Lucia, with PS5 and Xbox Series X|S named as platforms.
timeline.tl_delay_may_2026.title: Release date set: May 26, 2026
timeline.tl_delay_may_2026.body: The first firm date, already later than the original 2025 window.
timeline.tl_trailer_2.title: Trailer 2 and the two leads
timeline.tl_trailer_2.body: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos take center stage, alongside official character and location pages.
timeline.tl_delay_nov_2026.title: Moved to November 19, 2026
timeline.tl_delay_nov_2026.body: Rockstar delays the game by about six months to finish it at the level of polish it wants.
timeline.tl_launch.title: Launch day
timeline.tl_launch.body: GTA VI releases on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
missable.hourglass_missions.title: Optional missions with an hourglass icon expire
missable.hourglass_missions.body: Some optional missions are time-limited: they show an hourglass on the map and disappear if you wait too long. Do them as soon as they appear. Missing one does not block trophies or 100% completion.
missable.keep_manual_saves.title: Finished story missions can't be replayed
missable.keep_manual_saves.body: There is no mission replay and no chapter select. The only way back is a manual save: there are 15 slots plus one autosave. Save at the start and end of every chapter, and before long missions.
missable.ch1_balcony_meditation.title: A meditation with Lucia at home (Chapter 1 only)
missable.ch1_balcony_meditation.body: After the mission "Down to Earth", talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is not a regular meditation spot, but it may count toward the Positive Mental Attitude trophy (not confirmed yet). It is gone after Chapter 1.
missable.ch1_shirley_jobs.title: Shirley's two side jobs (Chapter 1 only)
missable.ch1_shirley_jobs.body: Shirley's optional jobs, fetching her rum and stealing a scooter, exist only in Chapter 1. They don't count toward trophies or 100%, so they only matter if you want to see everything.
missable.ch3_yago_race.title: Yago's race (Chapter 3, time-limited)
missable.ch3_yago_race.body: Yago's third quest, a race, is time-limited. Take it as soon as it shows up on the map. It doesn't count toward trophies or 100%.
missable.ch4_free_call.title: A phone call for Lucia (Chapter 4, time-limited)
missable.ch4_free_call.body: The optional mission "This is a Free Call From…", where Lucia picks up Shayna, is time-limited and can only be played as Lucia. Do it while it is on the map.
news.news_reviews_99.title: GTA VI scores 99 on Metacritic, tying the all-time record
news.news_reviews_99.summary: Critics are close to unanimous: 99 on Metacritic and 98 on OpenCritic. The most common complaints are the 30 FPS lock on consoles and slow stretches late in the story.
news.news_no_replay.title: No mission replay in GTA VI: keep manual saves
news.news_no_replay.summary: Finished story missions can't be replayed and there is no chapter select. You get 15 manual save slots and one autosave, so a few things can be missed for good. Our list tracks them.
news.news_trophies.title: 55 trophies, about 200 hours to the platinum
news.news_trophies.summary: The list has 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze trophies, none of them online. One trophy, Positive Mental Attitude, may be missable in Chapter 1.
news.news_completion_counts.title: How big is 100%? The first counts are in
news.news_completion_counts.summary: Early counts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge passes, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps, 18 meditation spots, 18 card sets, 39 gang operations and 8 bank vaults. The in-game 100% checklist unlocks after the story.
news.news_cash_tip.title: Early tip: stash your cash before the bank unlocks
news.news_cash_tip.summary: There is no bank account until the mission "Buck Me", and dying or getting arrested costs the cash you carry. Stash it under the loose floorboards in Jason's bedroom.
news.news_30fps.title: Locked to 30 FPS on every console, PS5 Pro included
news.news_30fps.summary: There is no performance mode. Reviewers report dips in big fights and chases. No PC version has been announced.
news.news_no_online.title: No online mode at launch
news.news_no_online.summary: GTA VI launches as a single-player game. Rockstar has not given a date for an online mode.
guide.first_hours.title: GTA VI first hours: tips the game doesn't tell you
guide.first_hours.lead: Small things that save money, time and progress in your first evenings in Leonida.
guide.first_hours.s.saves.title: Save by hand, and often
guide.first_hours.s.saves.body:
Finished story missions can't be replayed and there is no chapter select. You get 15 manual save slots and one autosave: save after the prologue, at the start and end of every chapter, and before long missions.

Cheats switch off trophies and saving, so keep them for a save you don't care about.
guide.first_hours.s.cash.title: Stash your cash until the bank opens
guide.first_hours.s.cash.body:
There is no bank account until the story mission "Buck Me". Until then, dying or getting arrested costs every dollar you carry.

Jason's bedroom has loose floorboards with a prompt: stash cash there whenever you pass by.
guide.first_hours.s.time.title: Days are long, and the clock matters
guide.first_hours.s.time.body:
A day lasts much longer than in earlier GTA games. Some shops close at night, some missions need day or night, and the police behave differently after dark. Your phone shows the time; sleeping at Jason's house skips the night.

Jason and Lucia also need food, sleep and exercise. Skipping them won't end your run, but it costs you on the three core stats: Health, Stamina and Focus.
guide.first_hours.s.buildings.title: Which buildings you can enter
guide.first_hours.s.buildings.body:
- On the world map, darker blue buildings have an interior; lighter blue ones don't.
- Up close, the minimap marks enterable doors with a white line and shows hidden rooms and stairs.
- In Focus, white doors can be opened and red doors are alarmed.
guide.first_hours.s.helpers.title: Two early helpers
guide.first_hours.s.helpers.body:
- Feed Jason's pet snake, Dolores, for an early Focus boost.
- After the mission "Just A Scratch" you can call your mechanic to fix the car almost anywhere. It isn't cheap, but it beats a long drive to a garage.
guide.first_hours.s.driving.title: Driving and fighting
guide.first_hours.s.driving.body:
Handling is heavier than in GTA V and early crashes are expensive. An older, low-profile car is easier to learn on and draws less attention.

In fights, use the world: any explosion opens a safe, no sticky bomb needed, and you can shove cars and hit people with car doors.
guide.wanted_level.title: Wanted level and Heat: how to lose the cops in GTA VI
guide.wanted_level.lead: What the stars mean, what the police know about you, and how to make them forget it.
guide.wanted_level.s.stars.title: What the stars mean
guide.wanted_level.s.stars.body:
The wanted meter has six stars, and how they look tells you how much the police know.

- Hollow: a crime was reported, but nobody has described you yet.
- Solid white: officers have identified you and can see you.
- Flashing white: you broke line of sight, but the chase is still on.
- Red: you got away; police are now searching an area for you.
guide.wanted_level.s.heat.title: Heat: what the police know
guide.wanted_level.s.heat.body:
Witnesses describe you over the police radio. Each detail they have shows up as a Heat icon next to the stars: your face or hair, your clothes, your car, your weapon, camera footage, or the fact that two of you were together. While an icon is active, an officer who sees that detail can recognise you again.

Police only react when someone calls it in or an alarm goes off: a witness on the phone, a robbery alarm, a stolen car's tracker. A crime with no witnesses and no cameras gives them little or nothing.
guide.wanted_level.s.clear.title: How to clear each icon
guide.wanted_level.s.clear.body:
- Face or hair: put on a mask or hat, or get a new haircut.
- Clothes: change the whole outfit; one accessory is often not enough. Keep a spare outfit in the car's trunk.
- Car: ditch it, take another, or repaint it at a Pay 'n' Spray.
- Weapon: put it away or get rid of it.
- Cameras: destroy the footage.
- Together: split Jason and Lucia up. That also drops the wanted level by one star.
guide.wanted_level.s.hot_areas.title: Hot areas
guide.wanted_level.s.hot_areas.body:
After you escape, the search zone stays on the map as a red area with a lighter ring around it. Going back too soon can get you recognised again unless your Heat icons are cleared. At six stars the search can cover the whole map.

Police don't show on the minimap. Focus reveals nearby officers through walls.
guide.wanted_level.s.profile.title: Your criminal profile
guide.wanted_level.s.profile.body: How you play changes how the police treat you. The more people you kill, the further your profile moves from Professional to Hardened, then Irredeemable, then Psycho, and the sooner officers reach for deadly force. Focus slow motion lets you aim for arms and legs instead, which keeps the profile cleaner.
guide.wanted_level.s.checklist.title: Quick checklist after a robbery
guide.wanted_level.s.checklist.body:
- Break line of sight first, then leave the red area.
- If you are together, split up.
- Swap the car and change the full outfit from the trunk.
- Put the weapon away before you walk past officers.
- Give it time before you return to the scene.
guide.completion.title: What 100% completion takes in GTA VI
guide.completion.lead: The full 100% list: what each part asks for and how much of it exists in Leonida.
guide.completion.s.overview.title: The big picture
guide.completion.s.overview.body:
GTA VI has 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, none of them online. Plan for about 200 hours to the platinum; one playthrough is enough.

The in-game 100% checklist unlocks after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Many parts don't need everything: the numbers below show what is required and what exists.
guide.completion.s.stunts.title: Stunts: 300 of 397
guide.completion.s.stunts.body:
- 130 stunt jumps
- 202 under-the-bridge passes
- 40 knife flights
- 25 base jumps

The Cunning Stunts trophy wants 250; 100% asks for 300, in any mix.
guide.completion.s.activities.title: Activities
guide.completion.s.activities.body:
- 30 of 40 unique races won and 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals
- All 42 shooting range gold medals
- All 42 drone time trials
- All 4 video games
- 5 of 7 pool opponents beaten
- 2 of 3 mini golf courses
- 90 of 100 basketball hoops
- 70 of 80 challenges
- All 15 of Bret's Target Decks (hunting)
guide.completion.s.missable.title: Can you miss anything?
guide.completion.s.missable.body: Nothing on the 100% list is known to be missable. One trophy might be: a meditation with Lucia that only happens in Chapter 1. Our missables list tracks it, along with other one-time moments.

guide.money.title: Money and robberies in GTA VI: what unlocks when, and what pays
guide.money.lead: Every kind of robbery, how marked bills work, how to hit a vault and what a fence will buy.
guide.money.s.unlocks.title: What unlocks when
guide.money.s.unlocks.body:
- Bank account: after the story mission "Buck Me". Until then you lose the cash you carry when you die or get arrested.
- Pawn shops: after "Coffee Break", halfway through Chapter 2.
- Bank jobs and Payday Loans: after "Credit Check" in Chapter 3, which also gives you the Dye Pack Jammer.
- Jewelry stores: after "Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs", halfway through Chapter 3.
- Bank vaults: after the Chapter 4 optional mission "That's Where The Money Is…".
- Selling cars: after the mission "Moses".
guide.money.s.targets.title: Types of robbery
guide.money.s.targets.body:
- Stick-ups (91 stores): convenience, fast food and liquor stores. Threaten the cashier, take the till, leave.
- Smash 'n' Grabs (35): pawn shops and jewelry stores. The display cases are not enough; the safe in the back room is what counts.
- Payday Loans (7): threaten the teller, empty the counter, then rob the back-room safe.
- Banks (22): the 14 small ones have a cash drawer and a safe; the 8 large ones add a vault.
- Gang operations (39, yellow icons): clear the site and take the key valuables. They come back, but only after a long time.

Once an area of the map is revealed, the map's Robberies filter lists banks and Payday Loans.
guide.money.s.marked.title: Marked bills and dye packs
guide.money.s.marked.body:
Cash from banks and Payday Loans is marked. It carries dye packs that burst if you take the money too far from where it came from, and one burst ruins the whole haul.

The Dye Pack Jammer from "Credit Check" makes it safe to move. Even then you can't spend marked bills: sell them to a fence first. Yasmani in Vice City is reported to pay the most.
guide.money.s.vaults.title: Hitting a vault
guide.money.s.vaults.body:
Vaults can't be picked or blown open. Follow an armored security van until it stops at a large bank: the guard carries cash in and the vault stays open for a short time. That is your window.

- One large bank can hold up to about $205,000.
- Bring your partner and hand bags over when yours is full.
- A vault job means four stars. A fast motorbike for the escape, then a car swap, works well.
- After two Payday Loans, Yasmani sells tips on van routes for $10,000.
guide.money.s.fencing.title: What a fence buys
guide.money.s.fencing.body:
Any fence buys everything:

- Narcotics, mostly from gang operations and cocaine flamingos.
- Jewelry, from the cases and back-room safes of jewelry stores.
- Marked bills, from banks and Payday Loans.
- Cars, after the mission "Moses". At first only cars without a tracker, at Moses's garage; later, tracked cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Randy's wish-list jobs pay the most.
guide.money.s.safes.title: Safes
guide.money.s.safes.body: Any explosion opens a safe; you don't need a sticky bomb. Anything nearby that blows up will do.
guide.money.s.checklist.title: What 100% asks for
guide.money.s.checklist.body:
- All 22 bank jobs and all 8 vaults
- All 7 Payday Loans
- 34 of 35 Smash 'n' Grabs
- 50 of 91 stick-ups
- All 39 gang operations
- Fenced: $100,000 in narcotics, $100,000 in jewelry, $250,000 in marked bills and $200,000 in cars
guide.completion.s.story.title: Story, tasks and crime
guide.completion.s.story.body:
- Finish the story
- 100 optional tasks
- All 39 gang operations
- All 22 bank jobs, all 8 vaults and all 7 Payday Loans
- 34 of 35 Smash 'n' Grabs and 50 of 91 stick-ups
- Fence $100,000 in narcotics, $100,000 in jewelry, $250,000 in marked bills and $200,000 in cars

Our money guide explains when each robbery type unlocks.
guide.completion.s.exploration.title: Exploration and collectibles
guide.completion.s.exploration.body:
- 15 of 18 collectible card sets (480 cards in total)
- 5 of 7 Kenton sets
- 100 WAiNK scans
- All 33 underwater discoveries
- 30 of 34 magazines, books and comics (7 of them are book swaps)
- 15 of 18 meditation spots (10 locations)
- 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos destroyed
- 70 of 79 clothing styles
- Both unique playlists
guide.completion.s.discovery.title: Discovery: vehicles, weapons, animals
guide.completion.s.discovery.body:
- 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned (the 280 standout variants don't count)
- 50 of 66 standard-issue weapons (53 guns, 9 melee, 4 explosives)
- 100 of 255 animals studied
guide.release_tracker.title: GTA 6 on PC, GTA 6 Online and FiveM: when?
guide.release_tracker.lead: Everything official and everything reported about the PC version, the online mode and roleplay servers, kept apart so you can see what is promised and what is rumor. We update this page whenever Rockstar or Take-Two says something new.
guide.release_tracker.s.summary.title: Status at a glance (18 November 2026)
guide.release_tracker.s.summary.body:
- Consoles: out 19 November 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
- PC: not announced. One report says early 2027
- GTA 6 Online: not at launch, no official date. Reports say 2027
- FiveM and roleplay servers: no GTA 6 support announced. Needs the PC version first
- Mods on PS5 or Xbox: not possible without breaking the console's terms
guide.release_tracker.s.pc.title: PC version
guide.release_tracker.s.pc.body:
Official: nothing yet. Rockstar's own page lists only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said in September 2026 that PC is becoming "more and more important" and that Rockstar launches on console first to serve its core audience. He has not given a date.

Reported: on 13 October 2026 GamesBeat wrote, citing four industry sources, that Rockstar plans the PC release for the first quarter of 2027. Rockstar did not comment. Treat it as a target, not a promise.

History for comparison:
- GTA V reached PC about 19 months after its console launch (September 2013 to April 2015)
- Red Dead Redemption 2 reached PC about 13 months after consoles (October 2018 to November 2019)

A Q1 2027 PC launch would be Rockstar's fastest port in years.
guide.release_tracker.s.online.title: GTA 6 Online
guide.release_tracker.s.online.body:
Official: GTA 6 launches as a single-player game. Rockstar has not announced an online mode, a name or a date. In August 2026 Take-Two said the current GTA Online keeps getting support and that players should not expect news about a new version soon.

Reported:
- Bloomberg reported in October 2026 that Rockstar plans the online mode for 2027
- Twitch CEO Dan Clancy also named 2027 in an interview

Neither is a Rockstar date.
guide.release_tracker.s.fivem.title: FiveM and roleplay servers
guide.release_tracker.s.fivem.body:
Rockstar bought Cfx.re, the team behind FiveM and RedM, in August 2023. Under Rockstar's rules, multiplayer mods are allowed only through those platforms. In January 2026 Cfx opened its own marketplace for paid and free mods for GTA V.

GTA 6 support for FiveM has not been announced. Roleplay servers run on PC, so they cannot arrive before the PC version. Today, roleplay still means GTA V on FiveM.
guide.release_tracker.s.console_mods.tit: Can you mod GTA 6 on PS5 or Xbox?
guide.release_tracker.s.console_mods.bod: No. Mods on console need a jailbroken or modified system. That breaks the platform's and Rockstar's terms and can get your account banned. Wait for PC if mods matter to you.
guide.release_tracker.s.watch.title: How we keep this page current
guide.release_tracker.s.watch.body:
- We check Rockstar Newswire, Take-Two earnings calls and Cfx.re announcements
- Anything official moves to the top with a date
- Reports stay labeled as reports until Rockstar confirms them

Take-Two's next earnings call is the most likely place for PC or Online news.
